'''Metal war axes''' were used by [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] warriors around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. They were also known to use [[Stone-bladed spear]]s, [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]] and [[tarpoon]]s.<ref name="Dengar">{{StoryCite|story=Payback: The Tale of Dengar|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref>
